The Library is committed to providing reliable, accessible, and user-friendly information materials and services that enrich academic excellence. Our collection includes a wide range of electronic and print information materials covering both local and international research. To ensure effective access and use of these resources, the Library continues to invest in skilled staff, modern technologies, and up-to-date facilities. Our dedicated team is always ready to assist users in finding, retrieving, and using information effectively. In addition, the Library offers a comfortable and well-equipped learning environment with adequate reading space, computer facilities, and quiet study areas to support individual study, research, and academic growth. THE LIBRARY CATALOGUE Use the library’s Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) to navigate through the physical holdings of the library. Generally the library maintains over 30,000 volumes of print books which support the core functions of the Institute Visit Now!! E-DIGITAL REPOSITORY Welcome to the University of Iringa (UoI) digital repository. The aim of this digital repository is to collect, preserve, and distribute scholarly output generated by the faculty, students, and research scholars in the course of discharging the core functions of the University which are teaching, research and consultancy.
